newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down amid fear of violence.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down amid fear of violence.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished lower on Sunday amid reports of clashes between police and demonstrators outside the house of Murtaza Bhutto, the slain brother of Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto, dealers said.
"Fear of violence spreading out and more troubles for the government forced investors to offload their holdings," dealer Khalid Hussain at National Finance & Investment Service.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 23.29 points, or 1.61 percent, to close at 1,415.52. Losers led gainers 156 to 78. PTCL fell 1.10 rupees to 34.40 and Hub Power Co 0.80 to 33.40. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
